root.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: Vienna Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 Bf5

overview: Black has taken the e-pawn with 3...dxe4, and after 4.f3 develops the bishop outside the pawn chain with 4...Bf5, avoiding 4...exf3. The common reply 5.fxe4 Nxe4 6.Nxe4 Bxe4 gives White fast development and the f-file against a solid Black set-up that equalises. The gambit is not really on offer here: White usually regains the pawn at once. White can try 5.g4 Bg6 6.h4 for an attack. The game is open and tactical.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture with fxe4 and aim for quick development
Use the f-file and Nf3, Bd3 to build an attack
Try g4 and h4 to harass the f5 bishop in sharper lines

black_ideas.idea: Trade pieces and neutralise the attack with ...Nxe4 and ...Bxe4
Stay a pawn up if White overreaches

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White's e-file and f-file half open after fxe4
Black e6/d-pawn gone structure with queenside majority

character.notes: Open play with attacking chances for White in the sharper lines, but the main fxe4 line is calmer.

gambit.notes: The pawn returns by 5.fxe4; the g4 and Gunderam lines are gambits.

soundness.notes: The main lines are sound; the speculative g4/h4 attacks are not.

structure.notes: Pawns come off in the centre, giving open files for the pieces.

approach.notes: The BDG is rare among strong players, who rarely choose it.

sublines_that_differ.name: Gunderam Attack
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 Bf5 5. g4 Bg6 6. h4
sublines_that_differ.how: White sacrifices a pawn and goes all out for a kingside attack.

character.reason: The main fxe4 line is calm, but the BDG often leads to sharp attacks.

gambit.reason: The pawn is regained by fxe4; gambit lines are sublines.

soundness.reason: The main line is sound; sharper branches are dubious.

structure.reason: Central pawns are exchanged and files open.

approach.reason: The BDG is seldom played by strong players.

plans.reason: White develops quickly and aims at the kingside.
